selection.ownership: Amilia Enterprises Inc., 1751 Richardson St Suite 3.105, Montreal, QC H3K 1G6, Canada. The reviewed edition is the global organization API at app.amilia.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Amilia API v3 organization docs (HTTPS https://app.amilia.com/api/v3/{language}/, JWT Bearer after GET /api/V3/authenticate with Basic, required orgIdentifier path, GET org/{org}/programs, GET org/{org}/programs/{id}, GET org/{org}/programs/{id}/activities, GET org/{org}/activities/{id}), Montreal Canada operator, SOC 2 Type 1 announcement, and dated incident search for Amilia security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved Amilia compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Amilia organization API v3 uses a fixed host app.amilia.com and a required stored organization identifier in the path, not a caller-supplied host. JWT is stored as api_key (GET /api/V3/authenticate with Basic is how operators mint the year-long token; native does not call authenticate). Dated 2026-09-13 incident search found no qualifying unresolved Amilia compromise.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
